description: Advanced dashboard for visualizing performance KPI results from the k6.io load testing tool, using the InfluxDB 1.x OSS exporter

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "vus" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(none)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "http_reqs" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "http_reqs" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m) fill(null)
SELECT count("value") FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT percentile("value", 50) FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT percentile("value", 80) FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT percentile("value", 90) FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT percentile("value", 95) FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT min("value") FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT max("value") FROM http_req_duration WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(null)
SELECT sum("value") FROM "checks" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s), "check" fill(none)

SELECT sum("value") AS Error_Count 
FROM "http_reqs" 
WHERE ("status" != '200' AND "status" != '201' AND "status" != '202' AND "status" != '204') AND $timeFilter

SELECT sum("value") AS Pass_Count 
FROM "http_reqs" 
WHERE ("status" = '200' OR "status" = '201' OR "status" = '202' OR "status" = '204') AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("value") FROM "http_reqs" WHERE ("expected_response" = 'false') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1s) fill(none)

SELECT sum("value") AS Error_Count 
FROM "http_reqs" 
WHERE ("status" != '200' AND "status" != '201' AND "status" != '202' AND "status" != '204') AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "name"

SELECT sum("value") AS Pass_Count 
FROM "http_reqs" 
WHERE ("status" = '200' OR "status" = '201' OR "status" = '202' OR "status" = '204') AND $timeFilter 
GROUP BY "name"
SELECT sum("value") FROM "http_reqs" WHERE ("status" != '200' AND "status" != '201' AND "status" != '202' AND "status" != '204' ) AND $timeFilter group by status, method, "name"
